descripcion_html:
Happy Birthday Banner with Balloons Flowers

Celebrate your special moments with our elegant Balloon Flowers Birthday Banner. With this decoration set, you can create a festive and elegant atmosphere at any birthday celebration without complicating your life.

Product Features

  • HIGH QUALITY BANNER - The garland is made of thick cardstock with white background and gold letters that form the words "Happy Birthday". This classic and elegant design is perfect for decorating the wall of the main party space.
  • DECORATIVE BALLOON FLOWERS - Set includes 2 flowers that are made with 5 pearlescent white balloons measuring 10 inches and 1 metallic gold balloon measuring 7 inches each. These flowers complete the garland with a special and elegant touch.
  • Easy to assemble: The balloon flowers are easily assembled with the rosettes included in the pack. See images for more information.
  • Practical presentation: The product is presented in a kraft envelope containing the garland and a zip bag with balloons and rosettes.
  • 【Full Content】Package includes 10 white pearlescent latex balloons and 2 metallic gold latex balloons for making flowers, plus 2 extra white and 1 gold balloons for replacement. The banner is assembled with a 5m ribbon included in the package.
  • GREAT FOR ANY PARTY : This set is perfect for decorating any birthday party, adding an elegant and festive touch that will delight all your guests.

Make your celebrations unforgettable with our Happy Birthday Banner with Balloon Flowers.
